title: Comparison and optimization of DNA Isolation protocols for high throughput genomic studies of Acacia pachyceras Schwartz
author: Habibi, Al Salameen, et al.

steps.title: Collect and store leaf samples
steps.instruction: Snip young leaves from branches, place immediately in labelled polythene bags, transport on ice to the laboratory, aliquot small portions, and store at –20 °C until use.

steps.title: Grind frozen leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Weigh frozen leaf pieces, crush them to a fine powder in liquid nitrogen using an autoclaved mortar and pestle; perform all isolations in triplicate.

steps.title: GenElute kit DNA extraction (Protocol I)
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from 100 mg ground tissue using the GenElute Plant Genomic DNA Miniprep Kit (Sigma‑Aldrich) following the kit chemistry.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µL Lysis Solution Part A and 50 µL Lysis Solution Part B to the tissue; vortex and invert to mix.
Add 50 units RNase A; incubate at 65 °C for 10 min with occasional inversion.
Add 130 µL Precipitation Solution; place on ice for 5 min.
Centrifuge at 12 000 g for 5 min; transfer supernatant to a filtration column and centrifuge 1 min.
Add 700 µL Binding Solution to the flow‑through, mix thoroughly.
Prepare the binding column by adding 500 µL Column Preparation Solution and centrifuge at 12 000 g for 1 min.
Load the lysate onto the binding column; centrifuge at 12 000 g for 1 min.
Wash the bound DNA with 500 µL Wash Solution, centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 min; repeat the wash two more times.
Perform a dry spin to remove residual liquid.
Elute DNA with 50 µL pre‑warmed (65 °C) Elution Solution; add to the centre of the column and centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 min. Repeat elution once more for complete recovery.

steps.title: NucleoSpin kit with CTAB buffer PL1 (Protocol II)
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from 200 mg plant powder using the NucleoSpin Plant II Mini kit (Macherey‑Nagel) with CTAB‑based lysis buffer PL1.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 200 mg powdered tissue to a clean tube.
Add 800 µL lysis buffer PL1 and 20 µL RNase A (50 U); incubate at 65 °C for 10 min.
Transfer lysate to a spin column; centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 2 min.
Add ~900 µL PC (precipitation solution) to the flow‑through, then transfer to the DNA‑binding column; centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 1 min.
Wash the bound DNA once with 800 µL PW1, then wash twice with PW2 (first 1400 µL, second 400 µL); centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 1 min between washes.
Elute DNA in 50 µL pre‑warmed (65 °C) PE (5 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.5); perform a double elution with the same column.

steps.title: NucleoSpin kit with SDS buffer PL2 (Protocol III)
steps.instruction: Repeat the NucleoSpin Plant II workflow using SDS‑based lysis buffer PL2 and the additional PL3 buffer.

substeps.instruction: Replace PL1 with 600 µL lysis buffer PL2; add 150 µL buffer PL3 (potassium acetate).
Incubate the mixture on ice for 5 min.
Proceed with all remaining steps of Protocol II, scaling all buffer volumes proportionally as recommended in the kit manual.
Elute DNA twice to maximise yield.

steps.title: Wizard Genomic DNA kit extraction (Protocol IV)
steps.instruction: Isolate DNA using the Wizard Genomic DNA Purification Kit (Promega).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL Nuclei Lysis Solution to 500 mg ground tissue; incubate at 65 °C for 15 min.
Add 3 µL RNase solution; incubate at 37 °C for 15 min.
Cool to room temperature, then add 200 µL Protein Precipitation Solution; incubate on ice for 5 min.
Centrifuge at 13 000 g for 3 min; transfer the upper aqueous layer to a fresh tube containing an equal volume (1 vol) of isopropanol.
Mix gently by inversion and centrifuge at 13 000 g for 1 min to pellet DNA.
Discard supernatant, wash pellet with 1 vol 70 % ethanol, then vacuum‑dry for 15–20 min.
Dissolve the dried DNA in 100 µL TE buffer pre‑warmed to 65 °C; incubate overnight at 4 °C to ensure complete dissolution.

steps.title: SDS‑based DNA extraction method (Protocol V)
steps.instruction: Perform a high‑yield SDS extraction on 1.5 g plant tissue.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 g tissue to 30 mL extraction buffer (100 mM Tris, 50 mM EDTA, 500 mM NaCl, 50 mM DTT, 20 mM potassium metabisulfite, pH 8.0); vortex thoroughly.
Add 2 g polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP, MW 10 000); revortex and allow the mixture to reach room temperature.
Add 5 µL RNase (10 mg mL⁻¹); incubate in a water bath at 37 °C for 60 min.
Add proteinase K to a final concentration of 100 µg mL⁻¹; incubate overnight at 37 °C.
Next day, add 3 mL 20 % SDS stock; mix and incubate at 65 °C for 15 min.
Add 12 mL 5 M potassium acetate (final concentration ≈2 %); mix and incubate on ice (0 °C) for 20–30 min.
Centrifuge at 15 000 rpm for 20 min at 4 °C; transfer supernatant to a clean tube.
Repeat the SDS + potassium acetate treatment two more times.
Add 0.6 vol isopropanol to the pooled supernatants, mix gently, and incubate at –20 °C for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 17 500 rpm for 30 min; discard supernatant and wash the DNA pellet twice with 70 % ethanol, centrifuging each wash at 10 000 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.
Air‑dry the pellet overnight and dissolve in TE buffer.

steps.title: CTAB DNA extraction (Protocol VI – original)
steps.instruction: Isolate DNA using a conventional CTAB protocol (Doyle & Doyle 1987).

substeps.instruction: Grind 1 g leaf tissue in liquid nitrogen to a fine powder and transfer to clean Oak Ridge tubes.
Add 15 mL pre‑warmed CTAB buffer (100 mM Tris‑Cl pH 8.0, 1.4 M NaCl, 25 mM EDTA pH 8.0, 2 % CTAB, ß‑mercaptoethanol, water to volume); incubate at 60 °C for 1 h with gentle inversion mixing.
Add 12 mL chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol (24:1 v/v); mix thoroughly.
Centrifuge at 10 000 g for 10 min at room temperature.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new tube using a wide‑bore pipette.
Add 0.6 vol isopropanol; invert gently to precipitate DNA.
Collect the visible white DNA with a bent Pasteur pipette and transfer to a clean tube.
Wash the pellet twice with 70 % ethanol, leaving it at room temperature for 10–15 min between washes; centrifuge each wash at 10 000 g for 10 min.
Discard the final wash, air‑dry the pellet overnight.
Dissolve the dried pellet in 15 mL TE buffer.
Add 100 µL of RNase (4 mg µL⁻¹) to the dissolved DNA; incubate at 37 °C for 1 h.
Store the extracted DNA at –20 °C until further processing.

steps.title: Apply modifications to CTAB protocol (Protocol VI – modified)
steps.instruction: When repeating the CTAB method, replace polyvinylpyrrolidone with ß‑mercaptoethanol and substitute phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol with chloroform:isoamyl alcohol as described in the modified protocol.
